rows.note: res.relay(in, 5) over a real TinyHttpd socket: no Content-Type, Content-Length 5, body 12345.
Two appended Set-Cookie lines both reach the wire over TinyHttpd, in order.
send, stream and relay (100 kB) completed over TinyHttpd, client closed, app shut down: listener never ran.
Client RST during an endless relay over TinyHttpd: each of two listeners ran exactly once, and the first listener's exception was logged through the app logger.
8 concurrent res.abort calls x 300 rounds: the listener ran exactly once each round.
8 registrations racing one abort x 300 rounds: no listener lost or run twice.

Exchange-reported abort (HttpExecution.cancel path) of a committed but uncopied stream in an async route: throwing listener logged to the app logger, second listener ran, ABORTED, input closed once. The first draft aborted after the copy had already completed; that tested the wrong scenario and was rewritten before the recorded run.
An exchange-reported abort during a running relay copy ran the listener on the reporting thread, not the request thread, and without the response monitor held.
HEAD relay and HEAD stream complete bodyless (COMPLETED), and a later exchange-reported abort runs no listener.
